# Getting Help

Thanks for using this GrepCut knowledge base. If you need help, here are your options:

## Documentation

- Check the [README](../README.md) for what this repository contains
- Visit [grepcut.com](https://grepcut.com/) for the product

## Issues

- **Content mistakes**: Use the content issue template
- **New page or translation**: Use the content request template
- **Questions**: Open a GitHub issue or ask on [Discord](https://discord.gg/jWmWGmJT)

## Community

- Follow us on [X](https://x.com/GrepCut)
- Join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/jWmWGmJT)
- Follow the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

## Response Times

- Issues are typically triaged within a few business days
- New page requests may take longer to evaluate
- Security issues are handled with priority

We appreciate your patience and contributions.
